description: Get detailed profile of any of the 27 Vedic nakshatras (lunar mansions). Returns ruling planet (lord), presiding deity, gana (temperament: Deva/Manushya/Rakshasa), symbol, core themes, and compatibility notes. Data sourced from classical Jyotish texts via star-meet.com.

name.description: Nakshatra name in English (e.g. "Ashwini", "Rohini", "Pushya", "Chitra", "Revati"). All 27 nakshatras supported.

name: get_nakshatra
